title: Champion of the Alchemist Conference
summary: To make a Three Lines Green Spirit Pill, Xiao Yan calls up a third flame: the Bone Chilling Flame Yao Lao left in the ring. The square turns cold, and the crowd is stunned that he holds two Heavenly Flames. His cheap cauldron cannot take three flames and explodes. Remembering Yao Lao's lesson, he shapes the Bone Chilling Flame into a cauldron and refines without one. Yan Li sends his poison servants to disrupt him, but Yue Er, Liu Ling and the other contestants pool their Soul Power to shield him. Yan Li finishes a Purple Heart Barrier Breaking Pill, but Xiao Yan's Three Lines pill rates as a strong Fifth-Tier Pill and Fa Ma names him champion. Xiao Yan collapses, and the fleeing Yan Li is caught; he begs to be made a spy, and Hai Bodong refuses.
events: Xiao Yan's Soul Power breakthrough steadies his refining.
He summons the Bone Chilling Flame, his second Heavenly Flame.
Yan Li calls his loyal servants to attack; Yao Ye's soldiers stand ready.
Xiao Yan's cauldron explodes; he refines inside the Bone Chilling Flame with no cauldron.
Yue Er, Liu Ling and the other young alchemists release Soul Power to protect him.
Yan Li completes a Purple Heart Barrier Breaking Pill (on par with Fifth-Tier).
Xiao Yan's Three Lines Green Spirit Pill wins; Fa Ma declares 'Yan Xiao' champion.
Xiao Yan faints; Yan Li is caught fleeing and begs to spy for Jia Ma; Hai Bodong refuses.
cultivation: No realm change. Xiao Yan's Soul Power has broken through; Fa Ma: "something that even some of the elders of our association won't be able to achieve."
